correctness.rationale: Every r-fold selected-simple-chord event has probability given by a double-factorial ratio, with the residual crossing count distributed exactly as the n-r uniform chord diagram. Counting circular r-matchings proves the full mixed-factorial and joint PGF law. Exact marginal moments yield the correlation; mixed factorial moments, bounded ordinary moments, tightness and conditional pgf uniqueness yield a product Poisson-Gaussian joint limit. The embedded finite checker passes 266 exact assertions for all matchings through 12 endpoints.

value.rationale: The exact bivariate transform reconstructs the entire joint law from classical crossing polynomials and derives a conditional Gaussian limit after excluding simple chords, an event of positive limiting probability. This resolves the local-vs-global dependence question that cannot be answered from separate marginal CLTs; it is an interpretable structural factorization, not an arbitrary numerical increment.
